Twisted Vibrations - Retail

Twisted Vibrations is at 301 Broadway in south Williamsburg, near Marcy Avenue and a block from the Marcy Avenue J, M and Z station. It is the smallest of the six licensed dispensaries we track in Williamsburg, with about 135 products from 44 brands. Flower is the biggest category at 41 listings, followed by 35 vapes, 23 pre-rolls and 22 edibles, with eight concentrates.

The brand list is more eclectic than the stock size suggests. STIIIZY is the deepest at 15 products, and Hurley, EUREKA, nama, Boukét and Ithaca Cultivated follow, which adds a couple of upstate New York growers you will not find at every shop. The entry price is $5.65 for Ayrloom singles in half-and-half iced tea lemonade, Honeycrisp cider, lemonade and rosé. For a bigger menu, Gotham Domino and The Flowery Brooklyn are each about 15 minutes north; Twisted Vibrations is the licensed option for south Williamsburg and the Broadway corridor.

Twisted Vibrations - Retail FAQ
Is Twisted Vibrations a flower shop?

More than most. Flower is its largest category at 41 of 135 listings, with Hurley, Boukét and Ithaca Cultivated among the New York growers stocked. That ratio is higher than any other Williamsburg dispensary we track.

Which train is closest?

The Marcy Avenue J, M and Z station is a block away on Broadway. It is also a short walk from the Brooklyn side of the Williamsburg Bridge.

How does it compare to Gotham Domino?

Gotham Domino lists about 515 products to Twisted Vibrations' 135. Twisted Vibrations wins on proximity for south Williamsburg and on a few upstate flower brands; Gotham has the broader menu.
